title: The Deserter's Trail
recruitHint: Dain asks for your help hunting a deserter from his unit. Refusing may cost you his trust.

onQuestFail.departureNarrative: Dain stops in the road. "You had your road. I have mine. That deserter won't wait for Roachak's deadline." He turns east without looking back.

epilogueComplete: Dain finally caught his deserter — and chose to stand with you at the end.
epilogueFailedDeparted: You later heard Dain caught the deserter near Vorishy, but he never rejoined your march.

title: The Missing Heirloom
recruitHint: Dain seeks a family heirloom lost on the road. He will remember whether you help.

onQuestFail.narrative: Dain stops speaking to you for days. The heirloom is gone — and so, it seems, is his faith in you.

epilogueComplete: Dain recovered his heirloom — a blade his father carried east.

title: The Marsh Herb
recruitHint: Emmy needs a rare herb from the wetlands. A small favour, she says.

onQuestFail.narrative: Emmy pockets her empty satchel without comment. The herb will have to wait.

epilogueComplete: Emmy's marsh herb saved three lives at a roadside camp.

title: An Old Debt
recruitHint: Lefty owes someone on the road a conversation. It may turn ugly.

onQuestFail.departureNarrative: Lefty spits in the dust. "I can't leave this unfinished. Don't wait for me." He vanishes into the treeline.

epilogueComplete: Lefty settled his debt — and stayed with you through Roachak's gate.

title: The Sick Child
recruitHint: Emmy heard of a child dying of fever in the next town. She asks you to make time for it.

onQuestFail.narrative: Emmy stops sharing her remedies. The child will have to wait for another healer.

epilogueComplete: The child Emmy saved sent a letter of thanks that reached you after the war.

title: The Stolen Map
recruitHint: Lefty lost a map that could shortcut the ridge. Recovering it matters to him.

onQuestFail.narrative: Lefty shrugs when you ask about the map. "Some things stay lost. So do some people."

epilogueComplete: Lefty's map led you through a ravine the soldiers never watched.
